item.title: Episode 1 - Welcome to Norwich
item.itunes:title: Episode 1 - Welcome to Norwich
item.description:
On this very first episode of Sneak Attack!, an original Dungeons and Dragons adventure. The gang of heroes first meets in the country of Norwich, a medium-sized island in the world of Brannis. They band together to help someone in need, and then continue travelling in search of fame and adventure.

 

Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast in order to stay up to date on when new episodes release, as well as behind the scenes looks at recording sessions!

item.title: Episode 3 - Wings of Fire
item.itunes:title: Episode 3 - Wings of Fire
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!: An Original Dungeons and Dragons Adventure, our intrepid band of heroes returns to Antwood in search of answers regarding the Pineapple Gang. Who do they work for, and why did they carry the same sigil as Juno, the tavern owner?

 

Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, and be sure to rate and review on iTunes, Stitcher, or wherever you are listening. We really appreciate it!

item.title: Episode 4 - Dungeons and Chickens
item.itunes:title: Episode 4 - Dungeons and Chickens
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the group leaves the statue and makes their way towards the bustling metropolis of Brightcove. Along the way they meet a hard-of-hearing chicken farmer by the name of Fuhrman, and Draagus, a mysterious tavern owner. What would the future hold for Draagus, and Fuhrman? Will Akio ever find a way into the base of the statue? Stay tuned, and thanks for listening!

 

Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, and please feel free to leave us a review on iTunes: http://apple.co/1JDyQId.

item.title: Episode 5 - Brightcove Streets
item.itunes:title: Episode 5 - Brightcove Streets
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, our heroes face the consequences of killing the two Pineapple Gang members, and creating a panic in the streets of Brightcove. Meanwhile Akio waits at the bar for the shady salesman Farlow to arrive. Would the group be able to sweet-talk their way out of this sticky situation, or will they face the music for their actions? How long will Akio wait at the bar?! Find out on this action-packed episode of Sneak Attack!

 

Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast and let us know how we are doing. We love all feedback, and really appreciate it. Or you can leave us a review on Stitcher or iTunes!

item.title: Episode 9 - Graduation
item.itunes:title: Episode 9 - Graduation
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the group decides what to do with all of the imprisoned children under the control of Melvin the deceitful orphanage owner. Then, they go on a journey of quiet self-discovery in an attempt to decide their fate in life, but nothing ever stays quiet and peaceful forever...

item.title: Episode 10 - A Capital Idea
item.itunes:title: Episode 10 - A Capital Idea
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, after coming to the startling realization that Greaek's had become infected by the mysterious black infestation, the gang meets with a local wizard in Brightcove who instructs them to seek the healing power of a Cleric in High Rock. With a world so devoid of any religious influence, would the Cleric even be able to help the dwarf? Stay tuned to find out!

 

Thanks so much for listening everyone! You can follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, and please feel free to rate and review us on iTunes! We really appreciate all of the feedback and comments.

item.itunes:title: Episode 11 - Pineapoleons Blown Apart
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the party recoils from their brief encounter with more mysterious portals, and musty continue their path to High Rock in an effort to find the elf cleric and heal Graeak's disease. item.title: Episode 12 - A Fork In The Road
item.itunes:title: Episode 12 - A Fork In The Road
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang's journey to the capital city of High Rock is almost complete! They just need to choose the best path to get there in the quickest amount of time so Greaek can have is leg inspected by the cleric who lives in the city. Will they make it in time, or will the road prove too perilous for our adventurers? Stay turned to find out!

 

Thanks so much for listening everyone! We have a Twitter account if you want to check us out there, @SneakPodcast. Also, if you are enjoying the show, please feel free to tell your friends, or maybe leave us a review on iTunes. We really appreciate every piece of feedback we get.

item.title: Episode 13 - Vince and the Zombies
item.itunes:title: Episode 13 - Vince and the Zombies
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, after finally arriving in the mountain city of High Rock, the gang settles down for the night at an inn named Saturn's Tavern and discover some rather interesting characters. Brenna and Akio are drawn towads an extremely curious set of individuals, while Greaek has trouble holding his alcohol.

 

Will the gang ever find the Cleric, and if so, will it be too late? Stay tuned to find out!

 

Thanks so much for listening everyone! You can follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, and please find us on iTunes and leave a rating or review.

item.itunes:title: Episode 14 - A Clerical Error
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang finally makes their way to the elven Cleric, Valaren Ellyndor, in order to seek a cure for the terrible disease plaguing Greaek's leg. item.title: Episode 15 - The Mountain of Sleuth
item.itunes:title: Episode 15 - The Mountain of Sleuth
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang climbs a mountain! Sent by the elf Cleric to investigate the crash site, the group traverses the tops of the Willow Peaks along with the ever-lovable Edwin. Would they find anything unusual high above the capital city, or would it be yet another dead-end on this difficult journey? Stay tuned to find out!

 

Thanks so much for listening everyone! We have a Twitter account you can follow us on, @SneakPodcast. Feel free to drop us a line, ask us a question, or you can leave us a review on iTunes! We really appreciate all of the feedback!

item.title: Episode 16 - Under the Mountain, Part 1
item.itunes:title: Episode 16 - Under the Mountain, Part 1
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang squares off against a hideous three-legged giant while in search of clues after the asteroid strike. Would they have what it takes to stop the beast, or have they finally met their match? Was the asteroid a sign, or just a freak astrological occurrence? What is to become of Greaek's illness? Stay tuned to find out!

 

Thanks so much for listening everyone, everyone at Sneak Attack! really appreciates all the love and support we received these last few months. If you want to get in touch with us, we have a Twitter account @SneakPodcast where you can let us know what you think, and tell us how we're doing! Or you can leave us a review on iTunes! We love all feedback we get!

item.itunes:title: Episode 17 - Under the Mountain, Part 2
item.description:

item.title: Episode 18 - Aftermath
item.itunes:title: Episode 18 - Aftermath
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang returns to the partially-destroyed city of High Rock fresh off their encounter with Malamet, the demon lord. They learned several interesting things about the history of Brannis, but are shocked back to reality when they discover the decrepit state of the capital city. Would they choose to intervene, or move on to bigger and better adventures? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening, we really appreciate your support! Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or leave us a review on iTunes and let us know what you think of the show! We love any and all feedback!

item.itunes:title: Episode 22 - Sleepytime Tea
item.description:
On this brand new episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang recovers from their near-death encounter with Orlaanx the Eternal; a dangerous vampire necromancer who had overtaken the quiet town of The Bay of Souls. Thanks so much for listening! We really appreciate and the support and feedback, and you can drop us a line on our Twitter account, @SneakPodcast. You can also leave us a review on iTunes or Stitcher, and be looking for our podcast on the Google Play store!

Thanks so much for listening! We really appreciate and the support and feedback, and you can drop us a line on our Twitter account, @SneakPodcast. You can also leave us a review on iTunes or Stitcher, and be looking for our podcast on the Google Play store!
